title: pp.grainer-mc~
description: `pp.grainer-mc~` is a granular sampler that loads or records audio into a buffer and sends each grain stream to an individual channel for multichannel playback or separate processing. Its channel/grain count is set by the first creation argument (default 8), and its second multichannel outlet provides a 0–1 signal ramp for each grain that can control effects at signal rate.
